title: Add document upload and scan pipeline

context.summary: Create the document upload service, upload API route wiring, scan job enqueue flow and ClamAV adapter.
context.background: TASK-7 added the queue layer. TASK-8 connects document upload to object storage and durable scan jobs while preserving async quarantine semantics.

in: Define document model, repository interface and upload service contracts in @mindory/core.
Store uploaded document blobs through ObjectStorage before creating Document metadata.
Create document.scan processing jobs through ProcessingJobDispatcher.
Register document upload and status API route stubs in apps/api.
Add @fastify/multipart dependency and route-level upload parsing for future runtime use.
Implement ClamAV scanner adapter using clamd INSTREAM protocol.
Implement a document.scan processor wrapper that reads from ObjectStorage and updates document scan status.
Add document upload and scan validation to repository checks.
Update API, document pipeline, security and worker documentation.
out: Wire real API runtime dependencies into buildApiApp.
Run ClamAV or Redis during validation.
Implement extraction, chunking, embeddings or indexing.
Change Docker Compose app runtime placeholders.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/core exports document status/model types, DocumentRepository and DocumentUploadService.
DocumentUploadService stores the original blob through ObjectStorage and creates a Document record with scan_pending or scan_clean status according to AV policy.
DocumentUploadService enqueues document.scan through ProcessingJobDispatcher when async quarantine scanning is required.
apps/api registers POST /v1/documents and GET /v1/documents/:id/status with structured placeholder behavior when runtime dependencies are not wired.
@mindory/processor-antivirus-clamav exports a ClamAV scanner using the clamd INSTREAM protocol.
@mindory/processor-antivirus-clamav exports a document.scan processor that updates scan_clean, scan_infected, scan_failed or quarantined statuses.
Repository checks include document upload and scan validation.
Documentation describes upload, quarantine and scan pipeline boundaries.
No concrete DB repositories, extraction, chunking, indexing or document search behavior is implemented.

manual_checks: Confirm upload service persists blob before document metadata.
Confirm API route returns 501 unless runtime dependencies are explicitly wired.
Confirm no extraction, chunking, indexing or search behavior was added.

risks: Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so Fastify multipart and TypeScript execution may need to wait until dependencies are installed.
ClamAV adapter is structurally implemented but not exercised against a live clamd service in this task.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
